title: Neo4j Ontology Graph Specification v1
description: Draft JSON Schema for the Ontology Graph spec v1 proposal (2026-09-25 doc state, working-session revision). Nodes and relationships are keyed by local ids; the label/type lives inside the entry. Types are tokens. Extensions ride the named extensions map: first-party keys, custom envelope under custom; extension payloads are never validated by this schema.

schema.description: Spec link including the version. Meta-level; doubles as document-type marker.

version.description: The ontology's own version. Identity metadata, not lifecycle.

nodes.description: Map key is the identifier within the document, not the label. The label lives in label / labels.identifier, so label renames do not break references.

relationships.description: Map key is the intra-document identifier; the relationship type lives in the type field. Several keys may share a type across different endpoint pairs, but note graph-type enforcement keys on the type alone and cannot distinguish pairs yet.

extensionsMap.description: Named extensions: first-party extensions as owner-prefixed keys (neo4j:*, ui:*, importer:*), each shape defined by its owner, available in the ontology graph spec SDK, not validated by this spec. Custom extensions ride the fixed envelope under the reserved custom key.

custom.description: Custom extensions, each in the fixed envelope.

reference.description: A single informational URI pointing at an external definition of this element (e.g. the original RDF resource).

node.description: Every node carries its label in label (shorthand for an identifier-only labels) or labels.identifier (when implied/optional labels exist). Not schema-enforced; a node with neither is meaningless.

label.description: Shorthand for labels.identifier when no implied/optional labels exist.

labels.description: Full labels object: identifier plus implied/optional labels.

properties.description: Properties of this node type; the map key is the property name.

propertyNames.description: Property names are non-empty (ADR-0010): the map key is the property's addressable name, the string constraint objects and extensions reference.

constraints.description: Constraint objects on this node type (the nameable alternative to the property flags).

aliases.description: Alternative names for this node type.

description.description: Human-readable description of this node type.

labels.description: The full labels object: identifier (the main label) plus implied and optional labels. A node with no implied/optional labels uses the label shorthand instead.

implied.description: Labels entailed by the identifying label (documented, never inferred).

optional.description: Labels that may be present on instances but are not guaranteed.

constraint.description: Constraint object form (the alternative to the mustExist/unique/key shorthand flags). Nameable, so tooling can reference individual constraints.

constraint_type.description: The constraint kind: key (unique + mustExist), unique, or mustExist.

properties.description: Names of properties on the same element this constraint covers.

name.description: Optional name, so tooling can reference the constraint.

propertyType.description: Type token: a Neo4j scalar, ANY, LIST<...> or VECTOR<...> (a VECTOR may carry a companion dimension field on the property). Element types are always scalars: no nested lists, no lists of vectors. VECTOR element types are numeric only: INTEGER or FLOAT (ADR-0012); LIST takes any scalar. No union types in v1: a property is a single type or ANY.

property.description: A property of a node or relationship type: a type token, optional value constraints (one_of, pattern), the shorthand constraint flags, and metadata.

dimension.description: VECTOR companion: element count. Absent = unconstrained.

mustExist.description: Shorthand for a single-property mustExist constraint.

unique.description: Shorthand for a single-property unique constraint.

key.description: Shorthand for a single-property key constraint (unique + mustExist).

one_of.description: Allowed values. JSON Schema's word. Default value support.

pattern.description: Regular expression the property value must match.

endpoint.description: Endpoint cardinality: count is the exact form, min_count/max_count the ranged form; absent means unconstrained (0..*). Counts on to constrain relationships per from-instance; counts on from constrain per to-instance.

node.description: A node id from the nodes map.

count.description: Exact relationship count per endpoint instance.

min_count.description: Minimum relationship count per endpoint instance.

max_count.description: Maximum relationship count per endpoint instance.

relationshipEntry.description: A relationship type entry: the type, its from/to endpoints with cardinality, properties, constraints, and metadata.

type.description: The relationship type. One-to-one with the map key in the common case; several keys may share a type across different endpoint pairs.

properties.description: Properties of this relationship type; the map key is the property name.

propertyNames.description: Property names are non-empty (ADR-0010): the map key is the property's addressable name, the string constraint objects and extensions reference.

constraints.description: Constraint objects on this relationship type (the nameable alternative to the property flags).

aliases.description: Alternative names for this relationship type.

description.description: Human-readable description of this relationship type.

extension.description: Custom extension envelope, four fields: type required; schema, name, definition optional. definition is free-form and never validated by this spec. Unknown extra fields are carried untouched.
